photos.c: Above: Having competed for St. Lucia in the Melbourne Commonwealth Games back in March, 19 year-old Darvin Edwards came to England and with high jump maestro Trevor Llewellyn, set about totally rebuilding his technique.  He had planned to go to the United States this winter but Darvin is staying in Britain and should be a huge asset to our British League teams in 2007.
